shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through air, cross-level work AI, and linked weather.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather); HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T2)
- Core: LevelComp registry on pocket maps aligned 1:1 (ground comp = column controller, now also the per-map stair registry maintained by stairs spawn/despawn); stairs pairs generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass with walkable ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core; guaranteed fog reveal on mineable removal; landings mine out and unfog their 3x3.
- See-below renderer: surface section submeshes at y=-2.5 (knowledge layers excluded BY TYPE: Darkness, FogOfWar, IndoorMask, LightingOverlay); air-cells-only light mask at y=-0.10 (base dim + real per-cell light, night cap 62%, padded rect + world-anchored grid + hysteresis, no fog inheritance); live dynamic things below via DrawPos offset flag; far clip 65.5 -> 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above live; sky floors write constructed roofs below; things over open air fall.
- Cross-level work (T2): when a colonist's local work scan is empty, the pawn is virtually placed at the linked stairwell exit (private position and map-index fields swapped and restored in a finally, the MultiFloors-proven technique; recursion-guarded) and the vanilla scanner runs on the other map. If work exists, the pawn takes the stairs and re-scans on arrival. Per-pawn 1200-tick cooldown (charged even on empty scans) prevents oscillation; drafted, downed, lord-bound pawns and non-colonists excluded; settings toggle; Movement kill switch.
- Drafted movement (T2): go up / go down gizmos on drafted colonists send them through the nearest linked stairwell (disabled with inline reason when no link). Stairs float menu remains for direct orders.
- Stairs placement (T2): buildable on all levels within the cap; links back to an existing level validate the matching target spot at placement time (clear of impassable edifices, medium-support terrain) and degrade to an unlinked stairwell with a message if the spot gets blocked before completion.

## Quadruple pass log
T2: lord guard added (never pull pawns from caravans/rituals); recursion guard verified; field swap restore verified in finally; cooldown bounds the double-scan cost; emergency+normal think instances covered by the shared cooldown; gizmo path skips reachability checks (per-GUI-pass cost). Confidence: cross-level work 85%, drafted gizmos 90%, stair registry 92%, placement validation 90%.
Known gaps (planned): pawns do not yet cross levels for FOOD, REST, or JOY (a colonist living upstairs must have needs met there until T3); prioritized right-click work across levels; multi-hop migration is organic (sky to basement requires an idle stop on the surface).

## Tranche plan
- T0, T1 series DONE (signed off). T2 CODE DONE (awaiting test).
- T3: logistics: cross-map stockpiles/hauling (user-flagged), storage awareness, bills across levels, cross-level needs (food/rest/joy).
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish backlog.

## Status
T2 compiled green, pushed. Pending test: idle colonist takes stairs to mine the basement, drafted gizmos, off-surface stair placement.
